patterns.note: Distorted, liquid-like display typography for chapter titles (e.g., 'RHYTHM', 'PULSE') that contrasts sharply with a highly structured, minimalist sans-serif for body copy.
Asymmetric editorial collage layout combining full-bleed studio portraits, overlapping close-up product shots, and offset text blocks.
Stark tri-tone foundation of warm off-white, deep black, and muted slate-blue portrait backdrops, punctuated by soft lavender and ice-blue product tiles.
Rhythmic chapter-based storytelling structure where each jewelry piece is introduced via an atmospheric portrait, a conceptual title, a multi-angle collage, and a dark-mode spotlight.
Smooth, momentum-based scrolling paired with an immersive audio-visual gatekeeper splash screen that sets a cinematic tone before revealing the content.

technique_notes: Implement a smooth-scrolling container using Locomotive Scroll to create a fluid, cinematic browsing experience.
Create a gated entry experience with a full-screen overlay that prompts the user for audio consent, fading out to reveal the main content once clicked.
Use CSS keyframes or SVG displacement filters to create a subtle warping/liquid distortion effect on the large display headings as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, heavily distorted display headers (~6x body) paired with clean, widely-spaced, medium-weight geometric sans-serif body text.

standout: The site treats e-commerce like a high-fashion audio-visual exhibition, organizing products into distinct sensory 'chapters' introduced by distorted, liquid-like typography and immersive soundscapes.
